programs.title: Fate of the Kidaverse
programs.desc: The gamers meet in the Kidaverse arcade in a test of fate. Host Frankie Vu watches as the kids select their pinball and add to their total score.

programs.title: The Big Dig/Catalog Slog
programs.desc: The Rangers discover that Preston Praxton has been causing earthquakes by digging underground  Preston sends out big, thick catalogs that overflow landfills.

programs.title: Preston Fest/Snakes on a Plain
programs.desc: Preston throws a music festival that destroys all the local vegetation, threatening local wildlife who are now going hungry  the Rangers help protect the lives of snakes during their migration.

programs.title: Magic Marker
programs.desc: JERRY, a curious and mischievous toddler, playing on the floor withsome toys. He notices amagic marker on the coffee table and picks it up.He starts to draw on the walls and furniture, creating colorful and abstract designs.

programs.title: Fashion Genes
programs.desc: In order to have the best girl modeling her designs, Nicky decides to clone herself.

programs.title: Analogwatch
programs.desc: Ellie realizes she's late to go home but gets confused about the time when her friends give conflicting responses. To clear the confusion, they seek help from Cuddle Power to learn how to read an analog watch. Through a magical journey, they discover the functioning of the hour and minute hands and successfully read the correct time.

programs.title: CHRISTMAS_PART 2
programs.desc: Unknown to the world, Thomas Edison built a secret lab where he invented a virtual version of himself and a robot named Von Bolt. With Edison as their guide, Angie and friends JD, Kent and Nicky set out to explore the fascinating world of science

programs.title: Hide and Seek
programs.desc: is a lively and comedic story of Jerry's birthday celebration. Jane surprises Jerry with a cake, but playfully keeps it out of his reach, leading to a chase around the house. Amidst the chaos, the cake ends up on the fan, creating further obstacles. Jerry and Jane search desperately for the cake, leading to a comical scene of mistaken discoveries. As the clock strikes midnight, signaling the end of Jerry's birthday, they become disheartened. However, a spontaneous cake mishap involving the fan brings laughter and joy to both characters, turning the situation into a hilarious and memorable moment

programs.title: SkippingRope
programs.desc: The Cubbies discover a skipping rope and decide to play with it. However, none of them knows how to use it correctly. Seeking help from Cuddle Power, they embark on a magical journey to learn the proper way to skip the rope and end up enjoying the playful activity.

programs.title: The Magic Ring
programs.desc: A trip to meet Mr. Arnold's friends Penn and Teller leads to a magical mystery that only the Super K's can solve: finding out what happened to Houdini's Ring.

programs.title: A Gem of a Deal
programs.desc: When a con artist purchases Nicky's granny's house for a fake gemstone necklace, the SECRET LAB KIDS must learn about minerals in order to save granny from ruin.

programs.title: Jerry the Golfer
programs.desc: Jane sets up the golf ball and takes a shot, which perfectly lands in the hole.Jerry takes a shot, but the ball barely moves.Jerry hits the ball, and it flies off, breaking a window
